goal: Let admins create a standalone Quiz content type from an uploaded set of questions, assign it to users with a passing score, and track completion and individual results.
constraints: Quiz questions are authored via JSON upload only, not an in-UI question builder
Passing score and retake-on-fail are configured once at publish time, not per assignment
Quiz is a seventh Training Library content type alongside Security Awareness, User Activity, Functional, Compliance, Custom, and Policies
assumptions: Quiz assignment reuses the same generic per-row Assign action used by other content types
Quiz-taking reuses the existing single-question-at-a-time knowledge-check UI pattern seen in module assessments
Quiz assignment emails follow the same template pattern as the observed 'New Policy Assigned' email
gaps: No dedicated Assign Quiz wizard was found distinct from the generic row-level Assign action
Passing score/retake are quiz-level, not assignment-level, unlike the Module assessment model
No validation behavior shown for malformed, empty, or oversized JSON uploads
Attempt exhaustion (failing all 3 attempts) has no defined end state
No edit/versioning flow shown for a published quiz
RBAC is entirely unaddressed in the designs
Wizard step labels are inconsistent across frames (Basic Info/Content/Publish vs Basic Info/Quiz/Publish vs Basic Info/Review/Publish)
No Quiz-specific notification template was found
edge_cases: Uploaded JSON fails to parse or has zero questions
Publish succeeds but success toast fails to render
Non-admin or view-only role accessing Quiz creation/assignment
50+ question quiz in the Review Questions list
Duplicate assignment to the same user
Admin re-uploads via Change file after reviewing questions
Learner leaves quiz in progress before completing
Learner exhausts all 3 attempts without passing
Keyboard-only and screen reader navigation through MCQ options and progress indicators

critical_questions.question: Does Assign Quiz reuse the full Assign Module wizard (audience tabs, due date, review step), or is it a lighter single-step action?
Is passing score/retake intentionally fixed per-quiz rather than per-assignment?
What validation runs against the uploaded JSON, and what does the admin see on a malformed or empty file?
What happens when a learner exhausts all 3 attempts without meeting the passing score?
Can a published quiz be edited/re-versioned, and does that trigger a re-take requirement for users who already completed it?
Which roles can create, publish, or assign a Quiz?
Should quiz assignment reject duplicates the same way module assignment does?
Is there a dedicated 'New Quiz Assigned' email, or does Quiz reuse the generic assignment template?

design_risks: Locking passing score at publish time risks rework if per-audience thresholds are later required
JSON-only authoring is a support burden risk without strong template validation and inline errors
Undefined attempt-exhaustion end state risks permanently stuck learners and suppressed completion/risk-score signal
Assign-flow ambiguity risks either over-engineering (full Assign Module wizard) or under-delivering (bare one-step action) audience precision
teaching_notes: Model Quiz on the Policy Library pattern (standalone content type, own Library tab, generic per-row Assign), not the Module pattern
The per-user quiz score drill-down mirrors the Simulated Attack 'Click details' audit modal already used on the End User Risk Insights page
